measures.name: Public Measure DA - Carroll Community School District General Obligation Bonds
measures.ballotLanguage: Shall the Board of Directors of the Carroll Community School District in the County of Carroll, State of Iowa, be authorized to contract indebtedness and issue General Obligation Bonds in an amount not to exceed $51,000,000 to provide funds to build, furnish, and equip additions to the high school and to remodel, repair, improve, furnish, and equip the high school and middle school, including site improvements, to facilitate the closure of Adams Elementary School?

notes: Read in a real browser (the official site is www.carrollcountyiowa.gov; carrollcounty.iowa.gov gives Cloudflare error 1000). The county posts a single 2-page scanned sample ballot (rendered and read visually). Both Supervisor District 2 and District 4 appear on the same ballot, so they appear to be voted countywide (residency districts) - each vote for one. Soil and Water Conservation District Commissioner is vote-for-two with no printed candidates (write-in only). Only one ballot style is posted (it carries the Carroll CSD measure), so township trustee/clerk races and any other precinct-specific measures in other parts of the county are not shown - marked partial.
